settings.heading: Build a bracelet bead by bead
settings.text: Pick your wrist size, then add polymer clay heishi beads one at a time. The bracelet fills up as you go and the price updates with every bead.
settings.size_note: Not sure? See the size guide below. If you're between sizes, go up one.

settings.caption: Size guide
settings.heading: Find your fit
settings.how_to:
How to measure

  1. Wrap a soft tape measure, or a strip of paper, around your wrist just below the wrist bone.
  2. Mark where it meets and measure the length in centimetres.
  3. Find your measurement in the table. If you're between sizes, or like a looser fit, go up one.

Buying a gift? A medium fits most adult wrists.
